GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Thank you
   D. Please

2. When practising Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.2 Intensive Reading.

3. When practising Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1: Descriptive writing.

4. When practising Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar 1.4.1 Verbs and Pronouns.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills.

6. When practising Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.2 Reading Comprehension.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Conversational skills.

8. When practising Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading.

9. When practising Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.2 Descriptive writing.

10. When practising Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing.

11. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Wasser
   C. Buch
   D. Haus

12. When practising Grammar, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.2 Scanning, Reading and Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.3 Functional and Informational Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 5.4.5 Verbs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.6 Listening for details and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.6 Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Descriptive writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar 6.4.6 Adjectives: Comparative and Superlative and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Dialogic Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
